_purpose: Lender-angle rules for cla_review. Every rule stays INACTIVE until its status is 'approved' (Enrico, Lucas); an inactive rule may raise an open question in the report but never a judgment. Values follow the proposal table in docs/cla-review-design.md, section 4, step 3. Change values here, never in code.

discount_minimum_pct.source: Swiss Angel Investor Handbook 8.3: 15 to 25% most common for angels; SECA band 5 to 30%; Enrico (design doc footnote 1): market 10 to 30%, 20% modal for a 12 to 18 month loan

discount_schedule_expected_above_months.source: SECA drafting note: discount correlates with term, rising schedule advised; Enrico (design doc footnote 2) on schedule variants

valuation_cap_required.source: SECA drafting note: cap often requested by investors; without it the conversion price is unbounded

denominator_fully_diluted_expected.source: SECA drafting note: fully diluted is the investor-friendly choice

qefr_threshold_minimum_multiple_of_aggre.source: SECA drafting note: not too low, or a tiny round converts the loans

qefr_threshold_maximum_multiple_of_round.source: SECA drafting note: not too high, or the company can avoid conversion

maturity_conversion_required.source: SECA drafting note: cap rarely accepted at maturity, fixed valuation or fair market value used

term_maximum_months.source: SECA drafting note: bridge until the next round; number is a placeholder

interest_safe_harbor_rate_pct.source: ESTV safe-harbor interest rate, published yearly; SECA drafting note and Handbook 8.3. Needs the current figure and its year.

coc_repayment_multiple_minimum.source: SECA short form: conversion or repayment on change of control

lender_majority_minimum_share_of_princip.source: earlier cla_review sketch: defined, at least two thirds of principal

exclusivity_flagged.source: Swiss Angel Investor Handbook: not recommended for angel rounds

non_bank_rules.source: Swiss Angel Investor Handbook 8.4, fixed by law; applicability and counting assumptions still need approval

valuation_grid_multiples_of_cap.source: for the cap-versus-discount crossover; uncapped loans need an explicit grid
